properties.description: Onboarding script. Open this in Synapse Studio to see what the lake holds, how to query it without spending money, and what the curated layer threw away.

content.query:
/* =============================================================================
   Exploring the NYC Taxi logical data warehouse
   =============================================================================

   Connect to: Built-in (serverless) / edw_lake

   READ THIS FIRST - serverless bills per TERABYTE SCANNED, not per query and
   not per hour. A careless SELECT * over the whole lake costs real money and
   nobody will stop you. Two rules keep you safe:

     1. ALWAYS filter on PickupYear and PickupMonth. They come from the folder
        names, so the engine skips whole folders without opening a file.
     2. Project only the columns you need. Parquet is columnar; SELECT * reads
        every column.

   Check what a query actually cost with query 6 at the bottom.
============================================================================= */


-- 1. Which partitions exist? Folder metadata only - costs nothing.
SELECT PickupYear, PickupMonth, TripCount = COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM curated.vw_YellowTaxiTrip
GROUP BY PickupYear, PickupMonth
ORDER BY PickupYear, PickupMonth;


-- 2. A first look at the data. Note the partition filter.
SELECT TOP (100)
    PickupDateTime, DropoffDateTime, TripDistanceMiles,
    PassengerCount, FareAmount, TipAmount, TotalAmount
FROM curated.vw_YellowTaxiTrip
WHERE PickupYear = 2024 AND PickupMonth = 1
ORDER BY PickupDateTime;


-- 3. Daily revenue, via the pre-shaped serving view.
SELECT PickupDate, TripCount, TotalAmount, AvgTripMinutes
FROM serving.vw_YellowTaxiTripDaily
WHERE PickupYear = 2024 AND PickupMonth = 1
ORDER BY PickupDate;


-- 4. Busiest pickup zones. Demonstrates the reference-data join.
SELECT TOP (20)
    PickupBorough, PickupZone,
    TripCount = SUM(TripCount),
    Revenue   = SUM(TotalAmount)
FROM serving.vw_YellowTaxiTripByZone
WHERE PickupYear = 2024 AND PickupMonth = 1
GROUP BY PickupBorough, PickupZone
ORDER BY TripCount DESC;


-- 5. What did the curated build reject, and why?
--    Computed on demand against raw - nothing is stored for this.
SELECT RejectReason, RejectedRows = COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM curated.vw_YellowTaxiTrip_Rejected
WHERE PickupYear = 2024 AND PickupMonth = 1
GROUP BY RejectReason
ORDER BY RejectedRows DESC;


-- 6. What did all of the above actually cost?
--    data_processed_mb is the billable number.
SELECT TOP (20)
    SUBSTRING(command, 1, 120) AS CommandPreview,
    start_time,
    DurationMs      = total_elapsed_time,
    DataProcessedMB = data_processed_mb
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests_history
ORDER BY start_time DESC;


-- 7. THE ANTI-PATTERN, for contrast. Do not run this on a full lake.
--    Filtering on PickupDate alone cannot prune folders, so serverless opens
--    every file in every month to find one day.
--
-- SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM curated.vw_YellowTaxiTrip WHERE PickupDate = '2024-01-15';
